I0 (phase-entry SHA) = 585f6b42f3bd221b20f38cd97d41b8d3fc5207ee. Repaired the single shared consumer-identity primitive _detect_caller_module in src/pcae/core/hpac_protected_admin_writer.py, the root cause shared by all four privileged factories the predecessor's blast-radius reconstruction identified (production_writer, certification_writer, recognized_certification_read_authority, mint_protected_presentation_evidence_writer). The caller-controlled early return (if explicit is not None: return explicit) was removed; the explicit parameter (the public _caller_module keyword argument on all four factories) is retained for call-site/signature continuity only and is now unconditionally ignored (del explicit) -- it can never influence the returned consumer identity. Real consumer identity is now, unconditionally, derived from actual call-stack provenance (inspect.stack() walking frame.f_globals['__name__']) -- the same fallback mechanism the primitive already had, now made the only path. This closes the finding for all four factories atomically since they share one primitive. Selected this mechanism (full removal of the caller-controlled override) over a fixture-only-gated-override alternative after prototyping the latter and finding it required threading two distinct signals through _run_recognition_sequence while still leaving an asymmetry for negative tests simulating an unauthorized real caller; full removal is simpler and satisfies the requirement exactly. No new trust root; no HPAC-PAWA-001 or any other contract byte changed; no PawaOperation/role/failure-code/schema/dependency change; AUTHORIZED_FACTORY_CONSUMERS/_TEST_FACTORY_CONSUMERS/_CERTIFICATION_TEST_CONSUMERS/_READ_AUTHORITY_TEST_CONSUMERS are byte-unchanged (confirmed: diff hunks do not touch those definition lines). mint_protected_presentation_evidence_writer's single-item inline test-consumer literal was extracted to a named two-member frozenset (_PROTECTED_PRESENTATION_EVIDENCE_TEST_CONSUMERS) as a pure refactor -- no widening of the authorized production set. Nine existing test files were updated to route through genuine call-provenance (new shared helper tests/_caller_identity_helper.py executes test calls from inside a throwaway module so 'legitimate' test identities are real, not asserted) instead of the closed override; a new dedicated suite tests/test_phase_n16_5_f5b2_impl_consumer_authenticity.py (49 tests) was added covering per-factory spoof-denial (exact name, near-miss, prefix, suffix, empty, wildcard), per-factory legitimate-caller success via real provenance, and cross-factory common-authenticity assertions. Load-bearing mutation proof performed: reverting the fix in a temporary copy made 10/49 new tests fail; the repaired file was restored (byte-identical to pre-mutation) and reconfirmed 49/49 green. Clean-installed wheel (python -m build --wheel, disposable /tmp venv, external script outside the repo/tests tree): spoof attack against all four factories 4/4 DENIED; legitimate production call path confirmed working from the installed package. A/B regression attribution: targeted band (-k f5b1/f5b2/h3/pawa_writer/protected_presentation/n16_5/certification/capability_integrity) on the repaired tree = 1823 passed / 37 failed / 2 skipped; identical band on the immutable pre-repair baseline (git stash push -u / rerun / git stash pop, restoration verified) = 1770 passed / 36 failed / 2 skipped. The single additional failure (test_128_admin_script_status_does_not_mutate_and_exits_cleanly_or_2) asserts an empty git diff and necessarily trips while this phase's own fix sits uncommitted; it is not a behavioral regression and is expected to clear once committed. 0 attributable regressions. H-3 five-role/session/subject/proof/counter/Gate semantics, F-5-B1 read-scope/configured-agent-bind/no-mutation/handle-lifecycle, and presentation-evidence/production_writer existing operation semantics all preserved (verified via the targeted regression band). No real ceremony (0 real certification sessions/challenges/helper launches/APPROVE/REJECT/getAssertion/makeCredential/PIN/touches/presentation evidence/counter mutations); no live protected-host writes; disposable tmp_path roots only throughout. pcae runtime inspect confirms not_implemented / Observed / observe / unavailable / 0 plugins / 0 capabilities -- no first governed runtime external effect created or made reachable.
